items.title: The Government of India Constitutes the ‘High Level Committee on Banking for Viksit Bharat’

items.summary: Indian visitors to the UAE and Singapore can now book experiences seamlessly with UPI. Indian visitors planning travel to two of the world’s premier destinations can now seamlessly book experiences and make online payments using their preferred Unified Payments Interface (UPI) apps. items.title: UPI Acceptance Enabled for Online Bookings at At the Top, Burj Khalifa and Resorts World Sentosa

items.summary: The Ministry of Coal today held a Stakeholder Consultation on ‘Mining for Future’ in Panjim, Goa. The day-long consultation brought together allottees of captive and commercial coal blocks, representatives of State Governments, CGWA, DGH, MoEFCC and senior officials of the Ministry to discuss faster operationalisation of allocated blocks, the next set of policy reforms, and responsible mining.
items.title: Ministry of Coal Holds Stakeholder Consultation on ‘Mining for Future’; Urges Allottees to Bring Allocated Coal Blocks into Production Faster
